title: Tolosa says trial remarks made ‘already on public record’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Counsel and spokesperson for the prosecution panel Atty. Benjamin Tolosa said that the statements he made regarding Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial flagged by the Senate impeachment court were already public record. This is in response to the impeachment court-issued show-cause order (SCO) dated Sept. 16 wherein the court flagged five public statements that Tolosa made during the House prosecution panel’s Sept. 8 press conference that may have violated the sub judice rule. “None of the challenged statements falls within the prohibition under Rule XVIII.
